name: Delphine
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c51354]Canary's[/url] personal bodyguard who has served her for two years. She isn't very talkative. 
[spoiler]She's been secretly dating Canary for the past year, and has always been concerned with keeping up a professional appearance, for Canary's sake. In her mind, their love was forbidden.[spoiler]
